format: html

  echo: false
---

```{=html}

body {

    radial-gradient(#ffffff 15%, transparent 16%),
```

```{r}
# Get all flag codes from the filenames in flags/ and pass them to Observable JS
codes <- sub("\\.png$", "", list.files("flags", pattern = "\\.png$"))
ojs_define(codes = codes)
```

```{ojs}
// Translate 2-letter ISO codes (plus the 4 UK nations) into readable names
regionNames = new Intl.DisplayNames(["en"], { type: "region" })
ukNames = ({
  "gb-eng": "England",
  "gb-nir": "Northern Ireland",
  "gb-sct": "Scotland",
  "gb-wls": "Wales"
})
labelFor = (code) => `${ukNames[code] ?? regionNames.of(code.toUpperCase())} (${code})`

// Helper to programmatically select a flag code in the dropdown
selectFlag = (code) => {
  viewof selected.value = code;
  viewof selected.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
}
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## 🔍 Explore & Search

```{ojs}
// Dropdown menu to pick a flag
viewof selected = Inputs.select(codes, {
  label: "Choose a flag:",
  format: labelFor,
  value: "us"
})

// "Surprise Me!" button picks a random code and updates the dropdown
Inputs.button("🎲 Surprise Me!", {
  reduce: () => selectFlag(codes[Math.floor(Math.random() * codes.length)])
})

// Display the selected flag image
html`<div style="margin: 1rem 0;">
  <h4>${labelFor(selected)}</h4>
  <img src="flags/${selected}.png" alt="Flag of ${selected}" style="max-width: 600px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 4px;">
</div>`
```

#### Searchable Flag Gallery

```{ojs}
// Text box to filter flags by country name or code
viewof search = Inputs.text({
  label: "Search countries:",
  placeholder: "Type a country name or code (e.g., japan, br)..."
})

// Filter the codes based on the search text
filteredCodes = codes.filter((c) =>
  labelFor(c).toLowerCase().includes(search.trim().toLowerCase())
)

// Render clickable flag thumbnails; clicking one updates the main viewer above
html`<div>
  <p><small>Showing ${filteredCodes.length} of ${codes.length} flags (click any flag to view it above):</small></p>
  <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(110px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; max-height: 360px; overflow-y: auto; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #eee; border-radius: 6px;">
    ${filteredCodes.map((c) => {
      const card = html`<div style="cursor: pointer; text-align: center; padding: 6px; border: 2px solid ${c === selected ? '#0d6efd' : 'transparent'}; border-radius: 4px; background: #fafafa;">
        <img src="flags/${c}.png" loading="lazy" style="width: 100%; height: 60px; object-fit: contain;">
        <div style="font-size: 0.75rem; margin-top: 4px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;">${labelFor(c)}</div>
      </div>`;
      card.onclick = () => selectFlag(c);
      return card;
    })}
  </div>
</div>`
```

## ⚖️ Side-by-Side Compare

```{ojs}
// Two dropdowns defaulting to look-alike flags: Chad (td) and Romania (ro)
viewof compareA = Inputs.select(codes, {
  label: "First flag:",
  format: labelFor,
  value: "td"
})

viewof compareB = Inputs.select(codes, {
  label: "Second flag:",
  format: labelFor,
  value: "ro"
})

// Build a comparison card that reads the image's natural dimensions once loaded
compareCard = (code) => {
  const info = html`<div style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #555; margin-top: 6px;">Loading dimensions...</div>`;
  const img = html`<img src="flags/${code}.png" style="width: 100%; max-height: 240px; object-fit: contain; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 4px; background: #f8f9fa;">`;
  img.onload = () => {
    const ratio = (img.naturalWidth / img.naturalHeight).toFixed(2);
    info.textContent = `Dimensions: ${img.naturalWidth} × ${img.naturalHeight} px (Aspect ratio ${ratio}:1)`;
  };
  return html`<div style="flex: 1; min-width: 240px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #eee; border-radius: 6px; text-align: center;">
    <h5 style="margin-bottom: 10px;">${labelFor(code)}</h5>
    ${img}
    ${info}
  </div>`;
}

html`<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; margin-top: 1rem;">
  ${compareCard(compareA)}
  ${compareCard(compareB)}
</div>`
```

## 🎯 Guess the Flag Quiz

```{ojs}
// Helper to generate a new 4-choice question while keeping score and streak
makeQuestion = (score = 0, total = 0, streak = 0) => {
  const shuffled = [...codes].sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
  const options = shuffled.slice(0, 4);
  const answer = options[Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)];
  return { score, total, streak, answer, options, picked: null };
}

mutable quiz = makeQuestion()

// Render the quiz UI and update `mutable quiz` when the user picks an option
{
  const q = quiz;
  const container = html`<div style="max-width: 550px; margin-top: 0.5rem;">
    <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 10px; font-weight: 600;">
      <span>Score: ${q.score} / ${q.total}</span>
      <span>🔥 Streak: ${q.streak}</span>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align: center; padding: 12px; background: #f8f9fa; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 6px;">
      <img src="flags/${q.answer}.png" style="max-height: 220px; max-width: 100%; object-fit: contain; border: 1px solid #ccc;">
    </div>
    <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; margin-top: 12px;">
      ${q.options.map((opt) => {
        let bg = "#fff";
        let border = "#ccc";
        if (q.picked !== null) {
          if (opt === q.answer) { bg = "#d1e7dd"; border = "#198754"; }
          else if (opt === q.picked) { bg = "#f8d7da"; border = "#dc3545"; }
        }
        const btn = html`<button style="padding: 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 2px solid ${border}; background: ${bg}; cursor: ${q.picked === null ? 'pointer' : 'default'}; font-weight: 500;">
          ${labelFor(opt)}
        </button>`;
        if (q.picked === null) {
          btn.onclick = () => {
            const correct = opt === q.answer;
            mutable quiz = {
              ...q,
              picked: opt,
              score: q.score + (correct ? 1 : 0),
              total: q.total + 1,
              streak: correct ? q.streak + 1 : 0
            };
          };
        }
        return btn;
      })}
    </div>
  </div>`;

  if (q.picked !== null) {
    const nextBtn = html`<button style="margin-top: 12px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: none; background: #0d6efd; color: white; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600;">
      Next Flag ➡️
    </button>`;
    nextBtn.onclick = () => {
      mutable quiz = makeQuestion(q.score, q.total, q.streak);
    };
    container.appendChild(nextBtn);
  }
  return container;
}
```

:::
